config.world: D5v4: D5v3's world with fresh seeds; the control bar taken per control. D5v3: D5v2's world with fresh seeds; the convergence bar on f_B(t) / f_B(0) at budgets 8 and above. D5's world with fresh seeds. Periodic Burgers u_t + u u_x = nu u_xx at resolutions N on a ladder, from seeded initial conditions of three Fourier modes at unit amplitude, viscosities nu on a ladder including 0; spectral observers with budget B (modes 1..B); the observational geometry of perturbations by a fixed seeded set of r smooth perturbation directions (spectrum 1/k) carried along the trajectory by the tangent solver and read through each observer, the read fraction (the share of a perturbation's energy in modes 1..B) being the observational quantity and the Gram matrix of the read images its geometry; the classical diagnostics beside every sample; decaying two-dimensional Navier-Stokes as the negative control with the same observers and estimator. Pilot: four seeded initial conditions at N = 128 and 256 and nu in {0, 0.005}, and a 48-squared control; run: four fresh initial conditions at N = 256 and 512 and nu in {0, 0.005, 0.02}, and two 64-squared controls with a stronger field over four time units.
